outer_folds: leave one of four training matches out; refit three, including C0 recipe
inner_folds: leave one of three outer training matches out; refit two; pool 12000 known rows per inner heldout/scenario
context: unsupervised fit on first lexicographic clean training match only, for every outer and inner fold
C0_training: original V1 clean/long_gaps/combined seed 20261026, 12000 rows per match/scenario, fixed logistic recipe
team_heads: identical training design for all J9 variants; exact fitted heads shared by state-only ablations
weighted_state: copy of C0 Newton solver with inverse-frequency weights in loss/gradient/Hessian, same L2 and convergence
temperature: convex fit of positive inverse temperature in [0.05,20], golden section 80 steps
platt: positive slope [0.05,20], intercept [-10,10], Newton 100 iterations, ridge 1e-8 numerical stability, projected backtracking
calibration_samples: only supported known inner OOF rows; D binary all known states, shared team conditional H/A with team support
neutral_fallback: D=1/3 when no physical support, conditional H=0.5 when no two teams, enforced after calibration
temporal_decoder: C0 static Viterbi, team scale 1 and D scale 2, prior refit on outer training labels
quantization: float32 probabilities before exact batch decoder, identical C0 archive contract
diagnostic_strata: observed/invisible ball, coordinate speed <0.5m/s or >=1m/s, visible ball without valid continuity link; descriptive only
label_convention: reuse original verified external BallStatus alive/dead plus controlling team H/A mapping; X excluded, no remapping or event supplementation
freeze: all 22 nine-way outer predictions hashed before opening held-out targets for scoring
adoption: internal screening only; no replacement or automatic submission; confirmation reserved J18
compute: CPU only; all preprocessing, outer/inner fits, inference and scoring charged to phase ledger
